sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 100 (all 158 campsites parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 5 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are not permitted at DEC campgrounds. Reservations need at least 2 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing.' A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

summary: Confirmed $22 + $5 non-resident and the 2-night pre-season minimum (DEC 2026 summary), opening May 14 2027 (matches). Added season close 09-05 (Labor Day), 162 sites (DEC) to 40 ft (103 sites; all back-in), no electric, 9-month window, 14-night max (DEC row, now on the entry), no walk-ins, showers, dump. AWH note kept; the minimum-stay line dropped (booking carries it).
flags: Season note (manual, 2026-10-20) says 'Reservable through Sep 5, 2027 (Labor Day weekend); DEC posts no later date.' DEC's 2026 summary does post a close: 'Mongaup Pond ... May 15 ... Sept 7' (Labor Day 2026). Suggest: 'Closes on Labor Day: Sep 7 in 2026 (DEC summary), Sep 5 in 2027 (ReserveAmerica).'
Missing phone: Mongaup Pond Campground 845-439-4233 (DEC 2026 campground summary).

Weak waterfront lead: ReserveAmerica tags every campsite 'Near Water - no', while the entry is lakefront (its own description says 'some on the lake'). Probably RA's default tag at DEC campgrounds; listed only because it is a booking-engine water claim contrary to ours.
